info.title: ArenaPass Backend API
info.description: Django JSON API using direct parameterized PostgreSQL SQL and Redis. No ORM. Includes rotating JWT sessions, OTP, atomic inventory workflows, support reservation review/correction, audit, worker-based expiration, and an optional Elasticsearch ticket-search backend synchronized through a transactional outbox. Includes authenticated direct chat between spectators and support agents with unread tracking and conversation status management.
